d: From Twilight's Edward Cullen to Hollywood's newest James Bond, Robert Pattinson's journey is one of the most fascinating career transformations in modern cinema. Once typecast as a teenage vampire, Pattinson reinvented himself through films like Good Time, The Lighthouse, High Life, The Batman, Tenet and Mickey 17, earning the trust of some of Hollywood's most acclaimed filmmakers. But what makes him the right choice for 007? And how did he become the internet's Mr. Everywhere?
